item.text: I’m checking Mistral’s official documentation for an index or machine-readable endpoint, then I’ll link the exact pages that support the answer.

Yes. Mistral publishes an LLM-oriented, machine-readable documentation index:

[https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt](https://docs.mistral.ai/llms.txt)

It is plain text in the `llms.txt` format and lists documentation pages with their Markdown URLs and short descriptions. You can provide it directly to a model or use it to selectively fetch relevant pages.

Mistral’s documentation also exposes pages in Markdown form—for example, the index links to `https://docs.mistral.ai/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md`. Their crawler documentation confirms that Mistral maintains automated documentation indexing infrastructure: [Mistral crawlers](https://docs.mistral.ai/robots).
